intro: A US$250 deposit, free registration and a demo account - that is the Sano Lucrivo offer in one line. The rest of the page is where the conditions live.
The platform is browser-only, with no app to install. Signals arrive from the models, trades execute through a broker partner, and the US$250 minimum opens access to 11 assets and the demo.
Our method is a desk review: no funded account, no trades. We read the published material in full, including unfilled placeholders and contradictions, and scored five fixed dimensions.

A US$250 minimum deposit to start.
Free registration, with account activation by confirmation link.
Risk settings adjustable before the first live trade.
A partner broker holding funds and executing orders.

faqs.q: What does the published score actually mean?
faqs.a: It does double duty - a platform score and an early community response - and neither is independently verified. Treat both as marketing until proven otherwise.
The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.

faqs.q: Does it offer a demo account?
faqs.a: Yes - a practice account is part of the package and runs alongside the live balance, which is the sensible first step before risking the US$250 minimum.
11 crypto assets through broker partners, per the published pages. The list varies between sections, so check the dashboard after signup.
The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.

bottomLine: The platform itself is workable - the dashboard, the demo and the two trading modes are all present. The caution applies to the claims around them, not the mechanics.

The score reflects the page: claims without verification, figures that conflict and restriction lists that disagree. Use the demo, deposit the minimum, and keep your own numbers - the page cannot be trusted with its own.
